CA.rationale: Content (red) has an explicit processing-origin relation (command_estimate) at the same candidate/future referent.

COD.rationale: Identified content (red at p0/current/n0), an explicit organization/origin entry, and a separate origin/status entry coexist for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: Origin fields label processing/estimation pathways (history_estimate, command_estimate) tied to specific content referents and times.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries name referents and attribute sets (red/blue) at current and candidate times.

D.rationale: Content lists (e.g. red coordinates) are presented separately from origin/organization metadata for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: Entries label how content is organized and where it derives from (copied_prior_record, command_estimate, inherited_current) and include display orientation.
